echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen plus 22.5% ATK to the next character on Outro; the Heron refunds her energy and buffs incoming DMG.

echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echo_sets.note: Game8's second pick: coordinated-attack buffs, but her mark-reliant procs are inconsistent.

build.energy_regen_target: around 120% (Game8's recommended mix so her burst uptime is not sacrificed)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Stringmaster + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Run a CRIT 4-cost, Electro DMG 3-costs (one can be Energy Regen), ATK% 1-costs, and land around 120% Energy Regen so her Liberation stays available each rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature and one of the best Rectifiers in the game — CRIT Rate, all-type DMG, and ATK that grows while she is off-field.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: 5-star stat stick; Basic Attack DMG converts into off-field DMG when she Outros.

ranked_weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
ranked_weapons.note: ATK plus Resonance Skill DMG and Echo Skill amplification after casting an Echo Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Free at Union Level 45; big ATK% substat that feeds her Basic-attack-driven kit.

ranked_weapons.name: Augment
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star: CRIT Rate plus an ATK boost after casting her Liberation.

stat_priorities.note: CRIT either way; Stringmaster already supplies plenty of Crit Rate.
Electro DMG ideally; one Energy Regen piece if burst uptime suffers.

profile.role_note: Electro and Liberation DMG buffer; deals off-field coordinated attacks against marked enemies.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Skip the character in the current meta — she is heavily powercrept — but her signature weapon Stringmaster is one of the best Rectifiers in the game and worth the weapon banner instead.

members.name: Yinlin
members.note: Moonlit Clouds carrier; marks enemies and provides off-field coordinated attacks.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healing plus All-Type DMG Deepen stacked on top of Yinlin's buffs.

teams.name: Premium: Xiangli Yao + Yinlin + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Yinlin applies Sinner's Marks, converts them to Punishment Marks and fires her Liberation, then Xiangli Yao swaps into her Outro buffs for his Liberation window.

members.note: Premier Electro DPS who scales off Liberation DMG — Yinlin's specialty buff.

members.name: Yinlin
members.note: Electro DMG amplification, a rare buff that Augusta converts well.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: General DMG amplification, Crit stats, and sustain.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Yinlin + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Same support flow as the premium team: Shorekeeper into Yinlin's mark setup, then Augusta swaps into the Outro buffs and runs her heavy-attack windows.
